newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - AEX technical outlook neutral to firm.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - AEX technical outlook neutral to firm.

text.p: Dutch chartists on Monday stayed neutral to bullish on the AEX index for the coming week.
ING Barings said the AEX was building a base formation with some upward potential but a breach of 555/556 resistance was needed to trigger a buying condition.
Fibonacci Press said the intermediate trend was still up with further gains expected over the next week or two.
IRIS said the technical picture improved with the breach of 555 last week but 565 needed to break for a bullish scenario, and this was not expected this week.
The AEX index ended at 553.39 points on Friday, 2.40 above the previous Friday. It shed 9.14 points the previous week.

ING Barings - Support just below 547 successfully tested twice last week, indicating buyers returning. Fast momentum lines now in positive territory (above crucial-0 level). In near term, current technicals indicate AEX completing base formation on upside, suggesting upward potential.

Fibonacci Press - Intermediate trend still up. Expected consolidation AEX to 546 probably enough. If correct, expect further gains for coming week or two. First resistance 570 and after that, 583 to 593, with 589 as most likely target. Only unexpected drop below 540 changes would turn us bearish.

IRIS - Technical picture of AEX improved with break of former short-term resistance at 555. However, for bullish scenario, AEX needs to break overhead resistance at 565. We do not expect a break this week, so we remain neutral. -- Amsterdam newsroom, +31 20 504 5000 (FAX 31-20-504-5040)
